_comment: THE CLAUDE CODE CAPTURE NERVE. UserPromptSubmit + Stop both fire hooks/afferent-post.mjs — a fail-silent (~250ms), stdout-free, secret-scrubbing bridge that POSTs to the thalamus (:4113) as a 'code' afferent. UserPromptSubmit captures HIS words (source 'claude-code'); Stop captures WHAT HE WAS TAUGHT (last_assistant_message, source 'claude-code-teaching') — so the WHOLE learning turn (question + answer) flows into the ONE working memory with zero capture tax. Relative command (CWD = project root); never blocks the session; thalamus down = silent no-op. THE FORGE PACER (30 Jul 2026): UserPromptSubmit ALSO fires `forge_session.mjs contract`, whose stdout IS injected by design — THE METHOD's 12-step order + the two anti-quiz-dump laws, re-read EVERY turn instead of once at skill-load (prose read once drowns after 40 turns; that is exactly how 8 of 12 steps went missing on the first live session). Silent unless a fresh, unclosed forge session exists; silent for headless organs (ARSENAL_ORGAN=1). THE BOOT LINE (31 Jul 2026): SessionStart ALSO fires `forge_session.mjs boot` — read-only, never writes, at most two lines, silent for headless organs (ARSENAL_ORGAN=1) and silent when there is no session and no history. It deliberately speaks on a STALE session: staleness silences the PACER, never the MEMORY. Companion: learnstate.mjs brief now splices the hippocampus rehydrate cartridge, so a fresh session arrives holding his durable memory instead of making him re-explain himself. THE TEACHING CONTRACT (31 Jul 2026): UserPromptSubmit ALSO fires `teaching_contract.mjs print`. The pacer re-injected the METHOD every turn but the HOW-TO-TEACH rules arrived only once, at SessionStart — and the measured result over a 5-hour session was zero method-drifts and four teaching-drifts (scope, role, language, terminology). This organ closes that asymmetry: <=5 lines, drift-RANKED (the rule he has been failed on most is injected first), rotating (every other rule still resurfaces), with the already-closed-concepts line DERIVED live from sprint.json so it needs no maintenance. It also carries the turn clock that raises his explicitly-requested CONTEXT WARNING before compaction, instead of relying on the model to remember to warn him. AUDIT #107 (5 Aug 2026): three fixes land here. (1) SessionStart now runs `teaching_contract.mjs reset-turns` FIRST — the organ's own header has named this the sanctioned session boundary since 2 Aug and it was never wired, so the clock had no reset path. (2) The CONTEXT WARNING no longer rides the turn counter; it rides the TRANSCRIPT'S SIZE, because a measured fork mid-conversation (session id bd2d46c2 -> fa94c375) zeroed the counter at exactly the moment the context was largest — #38's failure mode inverted from 'always fires' into the worse, silent 'never fires'. The new transcript file inherited the history (710,280 -> 958,257 bytes), so size carries across a fork where identity does not. (3) PreCompact now prints the kickoff brief, so orientation survives into the compacted context instead of depending on SessionStart's compact-source firing. THE CONTEXT MANIFEST (5 Aug 2026): `learnstate.mjs brief` now renders through scripts/context_manifest.mjs — an explicit 12,000-char budget spent worst-priority-first, with a footer naming every part's byte count and anything missing or trimmed. It exists because the brief silently dropped 1,957 of the hippocampus cartridge's 4,157 characters at EVERY SessionStart, and because the PENDING IDENTITY FACTS queue had no path into the brief at all. Size was never the problem; silent loss was. THE COMPLIANCE AUDIT'S SECOND HOOK (7 Aug 2026, self-sustaining repair): teaching_audit.mjs now ALSO fires on UserPromptSubmit — the Stop payload carries NO user text (afferent-post.mjs:59-62 is the field map), so the confusion-is-literal check could never see his words until the prompt was recorded at prompt time and consumed at Stop. Stop-side it audits the turn against the live forge session (the reader that expected a `.session` wrapper never audited a single turn — BRIEF__self_sustaining_organism.md §5.1), auto-counts measured drifts per his 6 Aug two-lane ruling, and stamps the checked_at heartbeat the close report has read since audit #40. THE WATCHMAN (7 Aug 2026): SessionStart also fires `watchman.mjs brief` — ONE line, only when last night's Tier-1 sweep found something or the watchman itself has not run; silent on a clean, fresh night. The organ that finally asks 'did the organ that was supposed to produce output today produce any?' — the question §5.1 survived precisely because nobody asked it.
